subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `AgentToolResult.control`, `yieldToolResult(...)`, and an explicit yield-capability marker as the permanent public Plugin SDK contract?
rationale: This adds a third-party API and changes model tool exposure; source and proof can validate implementation, but only maintainers can approve the lasting SDK and catalog contract.

options.title: Approve the narrow yield contract
options.body: Keep result-level yield, add a typed yield-capability declaration, and restrict direct catalog exposure to tools declaring both sequential execution and yield capability.

options.title: Redesign the host seam
options.body: Pause this PR and replace the public result control with a different maintainer-owned callback or tool-definition API before external plugins depend on it.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow yield contract
recommendation.body: Keep result-level yield, add a typed yield-capability declaration, and restrict direct catalog exposure to tools declaring both sequential execution and yield capability.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed and merged the existing turn-yield primitive that this API extends.
